description: Create a TaskRouter Task on a Workspace. TaskRouter routes work (calls, chats, tickets) to eligible Workers based on attributes.

Attributes.description: JSON string of task attributes used for routing (e.g. {"selected_language":"pt-br"})

TaskChannel.description: Task channel unique_name or SID (e.g. voice, chat, sms, default)

Timeout.description: Seconds before the task times out (default 86400)

WorkflowSid.description: Workflow SID (WW...) that decides how this task is routed

name: create_taskrouter_task
